# .github Folder

This folder contains GitHub-specific configuration files for CI/CD and automation.

## Contents

### Workflows (`workflows/`)
- `ci-cd.yml` - Main CI/CD pipeline for testing and publishing
- `publish-on-tag.yml` - Automatic publishing when version tags are pushed
- `test-pr.yml` - Test suite for pull requests

### Documentation
- `ACTIONS_SETUP.md` - Complete setup guide for GitHub Actions
- `RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md` - Step-by-step release checklist
